reason: $24.99 for a month is a price I'll try once, and a named lab report I can check is more than most magnesium brands give me. The pre-counted sachet helps since I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to keep up with, and it's made in China. If the lab report turns out to be vague I'm out, and after the launch price it's $29.99 which is a lot for one thing I may stop taking.
would_change_my_mind: If the price stayed above $29.99 for a single box with no coupon, or the QR code report didn't show my batch number, I would skip it.
